about_the_game:
First person speedrunning platformer set in a somewhat distant future

You are an average joe called Bob, who is going to fulfill his dream because he has been chosen by the government to become the next agent in order to help everyone

Key gameplay features:

  • Beat your personal times and your friends' as well when speedrunning all the levels

  • Master the movement in order to maintain the most speed

  • Practice your aim with given items so you can eliminate all the various targets across all levels

  • Learn all the abilities you will acquire throughout the game to create movement enhancing synergies

  • You have full control over your path. Create your own one and outsmart everyone else.

  • Bob's dream is in your hands, do not fail him. Become the best agent out there

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes damaging and killing enemies as well as display of player being injured.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4460 | AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 | AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 69 GB available space

short_description: Agent Bob is a single-player speedrunning platformer featuring movement-enhancing abilities. Create your own paths to achieve the fastest times.
